adaptations: CNN: four hidden 3-kernel GELU layers, width16, no normalization, linear pointwise field head

UNet: three pools, base8, double same-padding GELU convolutions, bilinear/trilinear interpolation align_corners=False, no normalization, field regression
3D residual/CNN are explicit dimensional lifts; no claim to a 3D classification reference
Existing PCNO GPL implementation and checkpoints unchanged
